posts.title: Libraries give us power
posts.description: I had a brilliant day at the Working Class Movement Library in Salford, wrapping up several research strands. I’m very grateful to the staff for preparing the boxes of material and audio recordings that I’d requested. It’s an amazing and important archive, and a wonderful resource for anyone interested in working-class history. Reply via email

posts.title: Brucefest
posts.description: In a windowless basement, somewhere in Birmingham, Geri and I joined a small huddle of world-worn web people to celebrate Bruce Lawson’s 60th birthday. Everyone managed to keep the whole thing a complete surprise for Bruce, who wore the same shell-shocked expression throughout the afternoon conference he unexpectedly found himself presenting. Couldn’t happen to a more lovely, beautiful, brilliant

posts.title: Gig at The Grove
posts.description: I’m playing at The Grove in Nottingham soon, supporting Foule , with Oiseaux also on the bill. It’s on Thursday 26th November. Tickets via Gigantic . It’ll be my first chance to air some new songs. I didn’t expect to play another show until sometime next year, as I’m focused on finishing the album, but I was chuffed to get this invite: playing live is a good catalyst for finishing songs and testin
